info.title: Real Estate AI Platform
info.description: AI-powered real-estate lead management: lead scoring (ML), requirement extraction (NLP), follow-up assistant, RAG chatbot, LangGraph agents and sales analytics. Demo data is synthetic.

post.description: Exchange email + password for a bearer token (OAuth2 password flow; `username` = email).

get.description: List staff (managers need this to assign leads).

schema.title: Response List Users Api V1 Users Get

get.description: Search, filter, sort and paginate leads (agents only see their own + unassigned).

schema.title: Response List Interactions Api V1 Leads  Lead Id  Interactions Get
Response Requirement History Api V1 Leads  Lead Id  Requirements Get

post.description: Record a new requirement profile (previous ones are kept as history).
Run the ML model for this lead and store the prediction (503 if no model is trained).

schema.title: Response Prediction History Api V1 Leads  Lead Id  Predictions Get
Response Recommend For Lead Api V1 Leads  Lead Id  Recommendations Get
Response Lead Follow Ups Api V1 Leads  Lead Id  Follow Ups Get

post.description: Schedule a follow-up written by a human.
Ask the follow-up assistant for a personalised DRAFT. It is not sent until approved.

get.description: Pending (draft/approved) or completed follow-ups, most urgent first.

post.description: Human approval gate: drafts (AI-written or not) become sendable only after this call.
Record that a human sent the (approved) message or made the call.

get.description: Rank available listings for ad-hoc criteria (structured match + optional free-text retrieval).

get.description: Marketing-channel comparison: volume, conversion rate, lead quality and cost.

get.description: Expected conversions from open leads plus a simple next-month trend.
Rule-generated, number-backed business insights (optionally summarised by an LLM).
Metadata, evaluation metrics and feature importance of the lead-scoring model.

post.description: Extract budget, location, property type, urgency and intent from a message (no writes).
